description: Repair or move the selected area on the active pixel layer by an offset: patch it from nearby pixels (Patch tool, Normal or Content-Aware), or move or extend it and fill the gap (Content-Aware Move tool). Needs a selection; dx and dy are the drag in pixels

color.description: How much colour blending, 0 to 10. Default 5

dx.description: Horizontal offset in pixels, positive to the right

dy.description: Vertical offset in pixels, positive downward

moveMode.description: Content-Aware Move: move the content, or extend (duplicate) it. Default move

patchFrom.description: Patch: source repairs the selection with the pixels at the offset; destination copies the selection to the offset. Default source

patchMode.description: Patch: how the patch blends. Default content_aware

sampleAllLayers.description: Sample all visible layers. Default false

structure.description: How closely the result keeps existing image patterns, 1 (loose) to 7 (strict). Default 5 for patch, 4 for move

transparent.description: Patch: blend the sampled texture transparently. Default false

name: retouch_selection
title: Retouch Selection
